title: Navimower 0.4.1-beta15

Beta15 is a diagnostic release focused on discovering the compact vendor error/event code that accompanies mower state transitions.

- Adds a bounded state transition capture around official MQTT named-state and numeric state/action changes.
- On a transition, performs read-only private-cloud captures immediately, after 1 s, and after 5 s using `index2`, `auth-list`, and `get-location`.
- Records selected before/after fields including `vehicle_state`, `error_data`, `boolState`, `permanent_data`, `m_task_status`, `map_work_position`, network state, battery and relevant timestamps.
- Adds `boolState` XOR plus set/cleared bit diagnostics as supporting evidence without treating the bitmap as an error-code source.
- Extracts vendor-looking code candidates from captured state/error/event fields so short-lived values such as `6007`, `180D`, `1817`, or model-specific equivalents are easier to spot.
- Keeps up to 30 transition events in memory and exposes them as `state_transition_capture` in Home Assistant diagnostics.
- Public Problem/Error entity semantics are unchanged; the decoded hint-error catalog remains lookup/diagnostic data only.
- No new pip requirements are added. Passive discovery can remain enabled during protocol research.

Diagnostics are intentionally verbose in this beta so cross-model tests such as an H215 lift event can retain the evidence needed for protocol analysis.
